subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw core accept `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` as a narrow provider-dispatch slice of the broader outbound rate-limit work after the branch is rebased onto current main?
rationale: The PR creates a new config/API contract and provider availability behavior while the canonical issue still needs maintainer scoping for budgets, CLI/status, tools/channels, and persistence.

options.title: Accept Provider-Dispatch Slice
options.body: After rebase and security-path preservation, accept this opt-in model-provider limiter as the first narrow core slice and leave budgets/status/tool-channel limits as follow-up decisions.

options.title: Require Broader Design First
options.body: Pause this PR until the canonical rate-limit tracker has one maintainer-approved design for provider limits, budgets, status, CLI, persistence, and non-provider calls.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR as unconfirmed product direction and invite a maintainer-sponsored replacement once the config and behavior contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept Provider-Dispatch Slice
recommendation.body: After rebase and security-path preservation, accept this opt-in model-provider limiter as the first narrow core slice and leave budgets/status/tool-channel limits as follow-up decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available product-scoping signal on the canonical issue and the recent security-boundary owner for this provider egress path.
